<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Transport in Iran]]
**[[Iran]]ian truck owners and drivers start striking in seven provinces to protest poor working conditions. [https://www.voanews.com/a/iran-truck-drivers-strike/4405564.html (VOA)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/truck-drivers-in-iran-on-strike-over-low-wages/2018/05/23/80f7b450-5ea3-11e8-b656-236c6214ef01_story.html?noredirect=on&utm_term=.19670a803982 (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Budget of France]]
**The [[European Commission]] recommends to remove France from the [[excessive deficit procedure]] which it entered in 2009. [http://www.dw.com/en/france-no-longer-in-eus-crosshairs-over-spending/a-43896580 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Economy of Turkey]]
**The [[Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey|Turkish Central Bank]] raises its "late liquidity window" rate from 13.5% to 16.5% in a move to counter the slide of the [[Turkish lira]] over the last three weeks. Other rates are left unchanged. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-05-23/turkish-banks-may-benefit-from-emergency-rate-hike-stable-lira (Bloomberg)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Transport in the Democratic Republic of the Congo]]
**A whaleboat accident kills 49 people in [[Tshuapa]] [[Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|province]], DR Congo. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-accident/congo-river-boat-accident-kills-49-official-idUSKCN1IP3VB (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-44253407 (BBC)]

;Health and environment
*The [[United States]] issues a health alert in [[China]], following a government employee reporting "abnormal sensations of sound and pressure", one in a range of physical symptoms, from late 2017 through to April 2018. [[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] says the [[United States Department of State|State Department]] is moving medical teams into place in [[Guangzhou]], adding that the incident was "entirely consistent" with [[Embassy attack accusations in Cuba|reported "sonic attacks"]] in [[Cuba]] in 2016 and 2017. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/05/23/asia/us-employee-china-sound-injury-intl/index.html (CNN)] 

;International relations
*[[Iran–European Union relations]]
**[[Iran]] sets seven conditions to stay in the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|JCPOA]] Iran deal after the [[United States withdrawal from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|U.S. withdrew]]. One of these conditions is that [[List of banks in Europe|European banks]] should safeguard trade with Iran. [http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/2018/05/23/Khamenei-sets-7-demands-to-remain-in-Iran-nuclear-deal.html (Al-Arabiya)]
*[[China–United States relations]]
**[[United States Department of Defense|The Pentagon]] announces that it has "disinvited" China from this year's biennial [[Exercise RIMPAC|Rim of the Pacific]] naval exercise, after China announced in January that it had accepted the United States' invitation. [https://www.politico.com/story/2018/05/23/us-china-naval-military-exercise-566721 (''Politico'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Corruption in Belgium]]
**[[Prosecutor#Belgium|Belgian prosecutors]] admit that a 2-year-old child was killed by police during a high-speed chase with a van last week, after initially denying it. [https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2018/may/18/belgian-authorities-admit-two-year-old-girl-was-shot-after-police-chase (''The Guardian'')]
*''[[Knight First Amendment Institute v. Trump]]''
**U.S. District Judge [[Naomi Reice Buchwald]] rules that public officials on social media should not block other users for differing political views. [http://fortune.com/2018/05/23/donald-trump-cant-block-people-on-twitter/ (''Fortune'')]
*[[Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting]]
**Six more families of victims of the 2012 [[Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting]] file a defamation lawsuit in [[Connecticut (state)|Connecticut]] against far-right radio show host and conspiracy theorist [[Alex Jones]], as well as his website [[InfoWars]] for his false claims surrounding the school shooting. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/23/us/alex-jones-sandy-hook-suit (''CNN'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Italy]]
**[[Italy|Italian]] [[President of Italy|President]] [[Sergio Mattarella]] accepts [[Giuseppe Conte]] as [[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]]. Conte is now going to form his government, supported by the [[Five Star Movement]] and [[Lega Nord|League]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-44223034 (BBC)]

;Sports
*[[2018 NFL season]], [[U.S. national anthem protests (2016–present)]]
**The NFL announces a new policy regarding kneeling for the anthem, requiring any players on the sidelines to stand. Thus, players will now be allowed to remain in the locker room while [[the Star-Spangled Banner]] is played, fining players who refuse to stand on the sidelines. [http://www.baltimoresun.com/sports/ravens/ravens-insider/bs-sp-ravens-nfl-national-anthem-policy-20180523-story.html (''The Baltimore Sun'')]
*[[2018 Stanley Cup playoffs]]
**The [[Washington Capitals]] will play the [[Vegas Golden Knights]] in the [[2018 Stanley Cup Finals|Stanley Cup Finals]] after a game 7 victory. It is the first [[Stanley Cup Finals]] appearance for the Capitals since [[1997–98 Washington Capitals season|1998]]. [https://www.nhl.com/news/capitals-golden-knights-set-to-face-off-in-stanley-cup-final/c-298766656 (NHL)]
